== Biography ==
<!-- BEE AutoBio start-->
Janet (Glasgow) Taylor was born on 9 Sep 1790 in Kirkliston, West Lothian, Scotland, daughter of [[Glasgow-159|John Glasgow]]  and [[Gray-6937|Agnes (Gray) Glasgow]].<ref>'''Scotland old parish records''' - Janet Glasgow - KIRKLISTON/WEST LOTHIAN Year 1790, Reference 667/00 0020 0220</ref>

Janet married [[Taylor-18010|Thomas Taylor]] (1788 - <1855) on 2 Jul 1808 in Aberlady, East Lothian, Scotland. <ref>'''Aberlady, East Lothian, Scotland Parish Records''', Thomas Taylor and Janet Glasgow - 2 July 1808, Aberlady. <br/>
Aberlady 17 July 1808<br/>
Appeared before this session Thomas Taylor and Janet Glasgow both in this parish and produced a certificate of their irregular marriage on 2 July they were rebuked before Sep declared married persons.
</ref>

Their children were:
#[[Taylor-18011|Alexander Taylor]]
#[[Taylor-18012|Agness (Taylor) Hood]]
#[[Taylor-17174|John Taylor]]
#[[Taylor-18013|Thomas Taylor]]
#[[Taylor-18015|Margaret (Taylor) Moodie]]

#[[Taylor-18043|George Taylor]]
#[[Taylor-18044|Janet (Taylor) Peden]]
#[[Taylor-18046|William Taylor]].

=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-159]] is assessed at 96% (proved). Janet’s specific 1790 OPR and 1874 death locators, marriage and censuses support one person. The father’s held findings explicitly derive his agricultural-labourer occupation from her death record, supporting the adult John/Gray family.

Janet Taylor→adult Kirkliston John-159.

Next useful test: Read the 1874 death parent fields with the 1790 birth entry.

=== Later derivative baptism review, 24 October 2026 ===

Two Findmypast index companions place a baptism of Janet Glasgow on 19 September 1790 at Kirkliston and name John Glasgow and Agnes Gray as parents; one also gives Kirkliston residence.<ref name="FMP-144-baptism">[https://findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685811032&tab=this Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', Janet Glasgow, baptism 19 September 1790, Kirkliston, parents John Glasgow and Agnes Gray, residence Kirkliston]; [https://findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_691880108&tab=this companion index]. Provider derivative transcripts inspected; original parish-register image not inspected.</ref> This fits the existing Janet (Glasgow) Taylor account. These indexes give a birth ''year'' only, so their baptism date must remain distinct from the already stated 9 September birth; they do not independently prove that exact birth day. The companions concern one event, not two independent baptisms. Her 1874 death, adult identity and existing 96% father assessment are unchanged.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-144 Scotland Death Certificate - GLASGOW JANET TAYLOR - TRANENT/EAST LOTHIAN Year 1874 722/00 0115]; [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-144 Scotland old parish records - Janet Glasgow - KIRKLISTON/WEST LOTHIAN Year 1790, Reference 667/00 0020 0220].
